made.name: fig01_risk_coverage_test
made.title: Risk-coverage curves, test
made.caption: Risk-coverage curves of every failure detector on the same 997 official test frames; risk is 1 minus the official frame IoU and a frame is bad when its official IoU is below 0.5 (bad rate 29.5%). AURC in the legend. The 4-model ensemble is test-only: every training sequence lies inside some member's training set. The MC row is MC stochastic depth (the segmenter has no dropout layer). Source: results/taskC/failure_detection.json and per-frame scores in work_v2/failure_detection.
